changeSet.sql: UPDATE tnt_delivery_announcements a SET sender_name = COALESCE(a.sender_name, LEFT(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', l.shipper_first_name, l.shipper_last_name)), ''), 150)), sender_phone = COALESCE(a.sender_phone, LEFT(l.shipper_phone, 30)), sender_email = COALESCE(a.sender_email, LEFT(l.shipper_email, 255)), recipient_email = COALESCE(a.recipient_email, LEFT(l.recipient_email, 255)), required_vehicle_type = COALESCE(a.required_vehicle_type, LEFT(l.required_vehicle_type, 40)), payment_method = COALESCE(a.payment_method, LEFT(l.payment_method, 30)), transport_method = COALESCE(a.transport_method, LEFT(l.transport_method, 30)), distance_km = COALESCE(a.distance_km, CAST(l.distance AS NUMERIC(10,3))), estimated_duration_min = COALESCE(a.estimated_duration_min, l.duration), destination_hub_id = COALESCE(a.destination_hub_id, l.destination_relay_point_id), handover_signature_ref = COALESCE(a.handover_signature_ref, LEFT(l.signature_url, 500)), service_fee = COALESCE(a.service_fee, CAST(l.logistics_price AS NUMERIC(14,2))), origin_ref_type = COALESCE(a.origin_ref_type, CASE WHEN l.delivery_need_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DELIVERY_NEED' END), origin_ref_id = COALESCE(a.origin_ref_id, l.delivery_need_id) FROM announcements l WHERE l.id = a.id

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE announcements ALTER COLUMN pickup_address_id DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE announcements ALTER COLUMN delivery_address_id DROP NOT NULL;

changeSet.sql: UPDATE delivery_needs n SET announcement_id = l.id FROM announcements l WHERE l.delivery_need_id = n.id AND n.announcement_id IS NULL
